ref_en: Go to the Tingen Grand Theater, there is a mirror there, and behind the mirror is the Safe House.

source_cn: 你真是个热心的好人，不过已经很麻烦你了，我想我们可以解决的。
ref_en: You really are a kind and helpful person, but you've already been troubled enough, I think we can solve it.

source_cn: 你能想象一位年长的病人突然向你展示了穿墙术的那种震撼吗？
ref_en: Can you imagine the shock of an elderly patient suddenly showing you the ability to walk through walls?

source_cn: 使用后获得<Highlight>苍白的死亡面饰</>
ref_en: Use to obtain <Highlight> Pale Death Face Accessory </>

source_cn: 俱乐部宣战期间暂时禁止进行成员变更
ref_en: Member changes are temporarily prohibited during a club war.

source_cn: 先噔，噔蹬蹬蹬，然后噔噔噔噔噔。
ref_en: First deng, deng deng deng deng, then deng deng deng deng deng.

source_cn: 光之折射会对命中的目标追加发射一根朗基努斯之枪，如果仅命中一个目标则会发射三根。
ref_en: Refraction of Light will fire an additional Spear of Longinus at the hit target; if only one target is hit, it will fire three.

source_cn: 公主殿下，放心交给我吧。
ref_en: Your Highness, please leave it to me.

source_cn: 再快一点，再快一点，总有一天，我也能站上舞台。
ref_en: Faster, a little faster, one day, I will be able to stand on the stage too.

source_cn: 占卜家天赋-命运赠礼被动
哦，不好意思，我现在有点太兴奋了。需要送你回恶龙酒吧吗，这里还挺远的。
ref_en: Oh, sorry, I'm a bit too excited right now. Do you need me to send you back to the Evil Dragon Bar? It's quite far from here.

source_cn: 在这么暗的地方画画？为什么不去娱乐室，至少那里有灯。
ref_en: Drawing in such a dark place? Why not go to the recreation room? At least there's light there.

source_cn: 处决致死通用状态buff（程序用）
ref_en: Execution Fatal Universal Status Buff (Program Use)

source_cn: 天呐，我明明看着它被扔进壁炉！我以为你只是说说而已……
ref_en: My god, I clearly watched it get thrown into the fireplace! I thought you were just saying that...

source_cn: 她很厉害，很坚强，我输得心服口服。
ref_en: She is very powerful and very strong. I lost, and I accept it wholeheartedly.

source_cn: 守知派最后一点东西。窥秘人的冥想方法，灵性感知的进阶技巧，还有一些关于隐匿贤者的研究。我用不上了。
ref_en: The last bit of the Knowledge-Seeking School. Meditation methods for Mystery Pryers, advanced techniques for spiritual perception, and some research on the Hidden Sage. I have no use for them anymore.

source_cn: 完成主线《加入黑荆棘》后解锁商店
ref_en: Unlock the shop after completing the main quest 'Joining the Nighthawks'.

source_cn: 对方队伍人数已满，加入失败
ref_en: The other party is full; failed to join.

source_cn: 希罗多德先生，我来归还资料。
ref_en: Mr. Herodotus, I've come to return the document.

source_cn: 很少，感谢查尼斯门不像我这样喜欢聊天。但我知道有人遇到过里面的封印物跑出来打招呼的情况。
ref_en: Rarely. I'm grateful that the Chanis Gate doesn't like to chat like I do. But I know of cases where someone encountered a Sealed Artifact that escaped from inside to say hello.

source_cn: 微表情、语气、下意识的动作——都是未被加密的语言。
ref_en: Micro-expressions, tone of voice, subconscious movements—these are all unencrypted languages.

source_cn: 感觉离开很长时间了……明明不久前才被调去贝克兰德教区。
ref_en: Feels like I've been away for a long time... even though I was only transferred to the Backlund Diocese not long ago.

source_cn: 我仍然能想起莎莉把它摆在显眼位置时，露出\n的狡黠笑容。
ref_en: I can still remember the sly smile Sally wore when she placed it in a prominent spot \n.

source_cn: 我睡前做了个<P_Yellow>转运仪式</>，从一本地摊上淘来的书里学来的，或许就是因为这个！
ref_en: I performed a <P_Yellow>Fortune-Turning Ritual.</> before bed, learned from a book I picked up at a street stall. Maybe that's why!

source_cn: 我知道你们关心我，可生活有时并不需要“团队合作”，你们不能替我做决定呀。
ref_en: I know you care about me, but life sometimes doesn't need "teamwork"; you can't make decisions for me.

source_cn: 或许还是蓝宝石更漂亮……

ref_en: So you are very good at investigations?

ref_en: The best Sonia golden spring marrow crystal—the victor picked it up from the corpse of a Feysac soldier.

source_cn: 梳起整齐的发式，是来到新家的第一课。爱与信仰照拂着孩子们，让灵魂虔诚而纯净。
ref_en: Combing hair neatly is the first lesson upon arriving at a new home. Love and faith shine upon the children, making their souls pious and pure.

ref_en: Royal Court Command reduces enemy Attack Power

source_cn: 由于规定时间内，我方伤害较高，本场比赛判胜。

ref_en: During Holy Armor, gain 40% damage boost, and enter a Blazing Sun state for 6 seconds after casting, which can stack duration with Blazing Sun states applied by other effects.

 Lady Rose sat in the Coastline Restaurant, while her friends were talking about the tailoring of long skirts and the position of the grandfather clock, but she had no heart to listen. 
 ... 
 Lady Rose felt bored with the life of a noblewoman—a boring and conceited husband, a son who was a carbon copy of his father, the hypocrisy of always having to maintain "decency," and so on. 
 ... 
 Perhaps the Goddess heard her prayer and allowed her to have an intersection with the Phantom Thief Black Emperor, who should not have appeared there.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>获取秘偶</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
“愚者”先生赐予的封印物<Assistant_Property1>乌托邦剧院</>，可以帮助非凡者获取并操控秘偶。
1、通过<Assistant_System>菜单-秘偶-获取秘偶</>可以进入<Assistant_Property1>乌托邦剧院</>，抽选<Assistant_Property2>秘偶</>，解锁对应秘偶技能。
2、乌托邦剧院戏台每次<Assistant_Property1>刷新</>会上架<Assistant_Red>3个</>秘偶，可供抽选。若抽选后戏台上只剩<Assistant_Red>紫色</>品质秘偶，戏台会自动刷新。
序幕抽选：消耗<Assistant_Property1>金纺线</>*3，从台上3个秘偶中随机获得1个。
中幕抽选：消耗<Assistant_Property1>金纺线</>*6，从台上剩余2个秘偶中随机获得1个。
落幕抽选：消耗<Assistant_Property1>金纺线</>*12，必定获得台上剩余的1个秘偶。
3、序幕抽选后，也可以主动<Assistant_Property1>放弃</>剩余秘偶，进行刷新。
4、进行<Assistant_Property1>秘偶许愿</>，选择特定的秘偶，可以提升该秘偶出现的概率。
5、重复获取的秘偶会转化为秘偶碎片，可用来进行<Assistant_Property1>秘偶培养</>，提升角色属性和增强秘偶技能。
6、秘偶培养达到上限后，溢出的<Assistant_Property1>秘偶碎片</>会转化为<Assistant_Property1>人偶发条</>，可以到<Assistant_Property1>秘偶商店</>兑换为其他道具。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[秘偶培养]|537}，{SendAnswer:[人偶发条]|543}，{SendAnswer:[秘偶商店]|545}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Obtain Marionette</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions: </>
The Sealed Artifact <Assistant_Property1>Utopia Theater</> bestowed by Mr. Fool can help Beyonders obtain and control marionettes.
1. You can enter the <Assistant_System>Utopia Theater</> via <Assistant_Property1>Menu - Marionette - Obtain Marionette</> to draw <Assistant_Property2>marionettes</> and unlock corresponding Marionette Skills.
2. The Utopia Theater stage will <Assistant_Property1>refresh</> and list <Assistant_Red>3</> marionettes available for selection each time. If only <Assistant_Red>Purple</> quality marionettes remain on the stage after drawing, the stage will automatically refresh.
Prologue Draw: Consumes <Assistant_Property1>Gold Thread</>*3 to randomly obtain 1 of the 3 marionettes on stage.
Interlude Draw: Consumes <Assistant_Property1>Gold Thread</>*6 to randomly obtain 1 of the 2 remaining marionettes on stage.
Curtain Call Draw: Consumes <Assistant_Property1>Gold Thread</>*12 to guarantee obtaining the 1 remaining marionette on stage.
3. After the Prologue Draw, you can also choose to <Assistant_Property1>give up</> on the remaining marionettes and refresh.
4. Perform <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Wish</> and select a specific marionette to increase the probability of that marionette appearing.
5. Duplicate marionettes obtained will be converted into Marionette Shards, which can be used for <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Cultivation</> to increase character attributes and enhance Marionette Skills.
6. After Marionette Cultivation reaches the limit, excess <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Shards</> will be converted into <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Clockwork</>, which can be exchanged for other items in the <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Shop</>.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Marionette Cultivation]|537}, {SendAnswer:[Marionette Clockwork]|543}, {SendAnswer:[Marionette Shop]|545}

ref_en: <Highlight> Free Speech Mode: </> All players can unmute and speak. \n<Highlight> Host-Controlled Speech Permission: </> In this mode, players can click the microphone button to request to speak; once the host approves, they gain speech permission. The host can also manually adjust speech permissions in the player list. \n<Highlight> Host-Controlled Speech Order: </> In this mode, up to 8 microphone seats can be set. source_cn: 我和几个学员从昨晚开始就在收拾东西，很快就能离开这诡异的地方了。\n　　可就在昨晚，又有两位研究员失踪了，还有几个人因为害怕而跑出了营地。我认为贸然跑出营地并不是理智的选择，因为野外的环境更加恶劣。\n　　我能看得出来曼斯教授也十分不安，但他是我们一行人的主心骨。他今天看起来是强撑着下达的指示，毕竟对于人类而言——未知是最古老最强烈的恐惧。
ref_en: I and a few students have been packing since last night, and we will soon be able to leave this eerie place.\n　　But just last night, two more researchers went missing, and several others ran out of the camp out of fear. I don't think running out of the camp rashly is a rational choice, because the environment in the wild is even harsher.\n　　I can tell that Professor Mans is also very uneasy, but he is the backbone of our group. He seemed to be forcing himself to give instructions today; after all, for humans—the unknown is the oldest and most intense horror.

ref_en: For afternoon tea, you can try lemon cake and small muffins, which can be paired with Feynapot's highland coffee or the sweet iced tea from my hometown.

source_cn: 不过话说回来，整个鲁恩王国都是这样，希望你不讨厌雨天。
ref_en: But then again, the entire Loen Kingdom is like this. I hope you don't dislike rainy days.

source_cn: 丰收的季节，啦啦啦……丰收的季节……
ref_en: The season of harvest, la la la... the season of harvest...

source_cn: 为了我的小萝拉能平安生活。
ref_en: For my little Lola to live in peace.

source_cn: 令人心动的未来-耍球失败
你们都去听瓜了就5个人在坚守串串房
ref_en: You all went to listen to gossip, only 5 people are holding down the skewer room

source_cn: 你懂什么！很快了，很快我们就可以拿回属于我们的荣耀！
ref_en: What do you know! Soon, very soon we can take back the glory that belongs to us!

先生，您一个人喝多没劲，而我恰好知道这瓶酒怎么喝最妙。

Repel the second wave of Spirit World creatures (2/3)

source_cn: 刚收到的礼物完全戳中心思，开心到想转圈圈！
ref_en: The gift I just received is exactly what I wanted, so happy I want to spin around!

ref_en: Carapon: Scum of Iron Cross Street—you rats have occupied the nest for too long, it's time to clear the place!

ref_en: I see, but... that scent of cold rain soaking white irises is something even the perfume used by the Loen royal family can't compare to!

ref_en: Invincible for 6 seconds when receiving fatal damage, while a marionette appears beside you, self-destructing to kill allies after 6 seconds; if the marionette is killed early, allies recover 70% Health, effective only once.

source_cn: 只是听人偶尔提起，说您的歌声……很有特色。
ref_en: I just heard someone mention it occasionally, saying your singing voice... is very unique.

ref_en: Oh? Terry Lisbon has passed away... My name is Dana, I live nearby.

source_cn: 唉，真希望能在豪尔斯街有一栋收租的商铺！
ref_en: Sigh, I really wish I had a shop on Daffodil Street to collect rent from!
Sigh, I really didn't expect I would lose...

ref_en: Mr. Danglars, I have decided to give up the investment in the Southern Continent railway project and withdraw all my deposits from the Intis Ocean Bank.

ref_en: Sun brooch, corresponding to the Bard Pathway Sequence 7 "Solar High Priest". Klein Moretti, in order to prepare for the battle against members of the Rose School of Thought, and to compensate for his own weaknesses in dealing with undead monsters.

Opening it gives a chance to receive <Highlight>Radiant Dew</>; there is a small probability that the box contains <Highlight>Foam Dye Cream</>, <Highlight>Coral Dye</>, or <Highlight>Star Coins</>.

ref_en: I was involved in a bizarre incident where everyone involved committed suicide in a strange way, yet I died and was resurrected... It's truly terrifying.

ref_en: There are no 'what ifs'! Landon, don't be afraid, you are the bravest.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【时虫宝藏】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>“恶作剧之神”阿蒙藏有时之虫的宝藏散落在各处，触碰时之裂隙能唤出阿蒙的谜题。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找时虫宝藏</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【时虫宝藏】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【时虫宝藏】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 开启寻宝</>
与时之裂隙互动，并完成与单片眼镜虚影的对话后，即可开启寻宝挑战。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 收集宝藏</>
根据指引寻找散落的宝箱，收集全部宝箱后即可开启最终宝箱，获得奖励。
<Assistant_Title1>【助手提示】</>
<Assistant_Red>灵视</>可以帮助发现隐藏的宝箱，建议在寻找过程中使用哦~
部分隐藏宝箱需要完成挑战后才能开启。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Worm of Time Treasure】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>The "God of Mischief" Amon has hidden treasures of Worms of Time scattered everywhere. Touching a Rift of Time can summon Amon's puzzles.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding the Worm of Time Treasure</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Worm of Time Treasure] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Worm of Time Treasure] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Starting the Treasure Hunt</>
Interact with the Rift of Time and complete the conversation with the monocle phantom shadow to start the treasure hunt challenge.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Collecting the Treasure</>
Follow the guidance to find the scattered treasure chests; after collecting all of them, you can open the final treasure chest to receive your reward.
<Assistant_Title1>【Assistant Tip】</>
<Assistant_Red>spirit vision</> can help you discover hidden treasure chests; it is recommended to use it during your search~
Some hidden treasure chests can only be opened after completing a challenge.

source_cn: 征服宣令</> 1、战略服开放期间，每周日12:00-19:30开放宣战； 2、宣战开放时，可向俱乐部神选积分排名与己方俱乐部差距在3及之内的俱乐部宣战； 3、可战斗时间为周日20:00-20:25、20:30-20：55两场，宣战方宣战时可自由选择任一时间段； 4、一个俱乐部可以同时被多俱乐部宣战，若被多个俱乐部宣战，各进攻方也互为敌对阵营； 5、俱乐部可同时处于宣战他人和被他人宣战状态，也可以同时宣战多个俱乐部，可在征服宣令界面在各战斗俱乐部场景自由传送； 6、战斗中，进攻方需占据上下两座征服之碑（任意进攻方即可，无需同一进攻方占据），方可打开战争之门，攻打征服旌旗； 7、若征服旌旗被攻占，进攻方全员获胜，并掠夺防守方神选积分，夺得尾刀方将获得更多神选积分； 8、若时间结束征服旌旗未被攻占，进攻方全员失败，将损失俱乐部神选积分，防守方获得神选积分。
ref_en: Conquest Decree</> 1. During the Strategic Server opening period, declarations of war are open every Sunday from 12:00 to 19:30; 2. When declarations of war are open, you can declare war on Clubs whose God-Chosen point ranking is within 3 places of your own Club; 3. Battle times are two sessions: Sunday 20:00-20:25 and 20:30-20:55. The declaring party can freely choose either time period when declaring war; 4. A Club can be declared war upon by multiple Clubs simultaneously. If declared war upon by multiple Clubs, each attacking party is also a hostile faction to the others; 5. A Club can be in a state of declaring war on others and being declared war upon by others simultaneously. It can also declare war on multiple Clubs at the same time and can freely teleport between various combat Club scenes in the Conquest Decree interface; 6. During battle, the attacking party must occupy the two Conquest Monuments (any attacking party is fine, no need for the same attacking party to occupy both) to open the War Gate and attack the Banner of Conquest; 7. If the Banner of Conquest is captured, all members of the attacking party win and plunder the God-Chosen points of the defending party. The party that lands the final blow will receive more God-Chosen points; 8. If the Banner of Conquest is not captured when time runs out, all members of the attacking party lose, will lose Club God-Chosen points, and the defending party will gain God-Chosen points.

source_cn: 这里是属于心灵、精神与意识的世界，个人意识如同岛屿漂浮在集体潜意识大海上，对于岛屿的影响也将投射到现实世界。在未知因素的作用下，集体潜意识大海的秩序崩塌，疯狂与混乱笼罩了越来越多的心灵岛屿。为了防止现实世界出现不可预知的危险，你决定接下奥黛丽的委托，前往风暴中心——那座巨龙盘旋的火山之上，调查与清除污染的根源。

Individual consciousness floats like an island on the sea of collective subconsciousness, and influences on the island will also be projected into the real world. Under the influence of unknown factors, the order of the sea of collective subconsciousness has collapsed, and madness and chaos have shrouded more and more islands of the mind. To prevent unpredictable dangers in the real world, you decide to accept Audrey's commission and head to the center of the storm—the volcano where the giant dragon circles—to investigate and clear the source of the corruption.

source_cn: <Yellow>弱点攻击</>：佩戴者攻击主目标时，可对其施加<Yellow>弱点揭露</>效果，每秒最多揭露1层，最多可揭露<Yellow>30</>层。每消耗<Yellow>15</>层，可扣下丧钟的扳机，攻击目标灵体，造成<Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=1?*d}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=2?*d}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=3?*d}</>点伤害、<Yellow>3秒</>受到治疗增幅降低<Yellow>70%</>和移动速度降低<Yellow>*f**</>效果，另有<Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=1?60%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=2?80%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=3?100%}</>的基础概率使目标眩晕<Yellow>1秒</>。若目标处于霸体状态，则对其重新施加<Yellow>3</>层弱点揭露。
ref_en: <Yellow>Weakness Attack</>: When the wearer attacks the main target, they can apply the <Yellow>Weakness Exposed</> effect, revealing up to 1 stack per second, for a maximum of <Yellow>30</> stacks. For every <Yellow>15</> stacks consumed, you can pull the trigger of Death Knell, attacking the target's spirit body to deal <Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=1?*d}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=2?*d}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=3?*d}</> damage, reduce incoming Healing by <Yellow>70%</> for <Yellow>3 seconds</>, and reduce movement speed by <Yellow>*f**</>. Additionally, there is a <Yellow>{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=1?60%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=2?80%}{CheckStar(Type="sealed",ID=2085001)=3?100%}</> base probability to Stun the target for <Yellow>1 second</>. If the target is in a Super Armor state, re-apply <Yellow>3</> stacks of Weakness Exposed to them.

source_cn: {{player.name}}对{{targetPlayer.name}}成功进行了安魂，对方躁动的灵性重归宁静，恢复了<Chat_Highlight>{{eventMessageParams.N}}</>点理智。赞美女神，一切的归宿是安宁！
ref_en: {{player.name}} has successfully performed a Requiem on {{targetPlayer.name}}. The other party's restless spirituality has returned to tranquility, restoring <Chat_Highlight>{{eventMessageParams.N}}</> points of Sanity. Praise the Goddess, for the destination of all things is peace!

source_cn: {{先生|女士}}, are you looking to rent a house?
ref_en: {{Sir|Madam}}, are you looking to rent a house?

source_cn: “我们是一群时刻对抗着危险和疯狂的可怜虫，也是廷根的守护者。”
ref_en: "We are a group of poor souls constantly fighting against danger and madness, and we are also the Guardians of Tingen."

source_cn: “正义”小姐馈赠的精致钱包，能够带来潜意识和心灵的守护，抵御部分非凡伤害。但负面效果是……产生强烈的花钱冲动！
ref_en: An exquisite wallet gifted by Miss Justice, capable of bringing subconscious and spiritual protection, resisting some Beyonder damage. But the negative effect is... generating a strong urge to spend money!

source_cn:
主教建议我种点水稻，早年她从精灵食谱中学过一种水稻做的美食，又甜又软，十分弹牙。


　　种植培育记录就这样写好了：
　　《“耕种者”途径对农田土壤肥力及作物生长的长期影响：以金秋湖地下遗迹的水稻种植为例》
ref_en:
The Bishop suggested I plant some rice. Years ago, she learned a delicacy made of rice from an elf cookbook, which was sweet, soft, and very chewy. 
 
 
 The planting and cultivation record is written like this: 
 "Long-term Effects of the 'Planter' Pathway on Farmland Soil Fertility and Crop Growth: A Case Study of Rice Planting in the Underground Ruins of Golden Autumn Lake"

source_cn:
我用一瓶您给的牛奶换来了邻居家孩子的代笔。
　　请原谅我如此冒昧，您的出现已经成了我每周里最期待的事——一位由香气构成的朋友。
　　我不知道你的姓名，也永远不会知道你的模样，但我希望能有一个认识您的机会。

　　若您愿意，下次来时，可否多停留片刻？让我给您一杯水，问问您的名字？
ref_en:
I used a bottle of milk you gave me to get the neighbor's child to write this for me. 
 Please forgive my presumption; your appearance has become the thing I look forward to most every week—a friend made of fragrance. 
 I don't know your name, and I will never know your appearance, but I hope to have a chance to get to know you. 

 If you are willing, could you stay a little longer next time you come? Let me offer you a glass of water and ask your name?

source_cn: 不枉我排了那么久的队！
ref_en: It was worth waiting in line for so long!

source_cn: 今夜琴声温柔-询问罗珊在理什么
ref_en: Gentle Piano Music Tonight - Asking what Rozanne is organizing

source_cn: 今日剩余双倍奖励次数：<Yellow>8</>/20
你在剧院的长椅上捡到罗塞尔写下的《美女与野兽》，这是一本能自主写作的神奇物品，它向你发起挑战，看看你是否能像罗塞尔一样，写出足以流传后世的精彩故事。你灵感大发，大胆改编《美女与野兽》，导演出了更吸引眼球的《魔女与野兽》！
ref_en: You picked up "Beauty and the Beast" written by Roselle on a bench in the theater. This is a mystical item capable of autonomous writing. It challenges you to see if you can write a brilliant story that will be passed down to future generations, just like Roselle. You are struck by inspiration and boldly adapt "Beauty and the Beast," directing an even more eye-catching "Witch and the Beast"!

source_cn: 你已经了解提问的规则了，走向下一题吧，就在你身后。
ref_en: You have already understood the rules of the questions; proceed to the next one, it is right behind you.

source_cn: 你所在的团队加入了联盟
ref_en: The team you are in has joined the alliance.

source_cn: 先跟瑞尔好好谈谈，然后带他去跟伊森他们道歉！让他们揍瑞尔一顿消气也可以！
ref_en: Talk to Ray properly first, then take him to apologize to Ethan and the others! It's fine if you let them beat Ray up to vent their anger!

source_cn: 原著 · 仪式魔法的前提
ref_en: Original Work · Prerequisites for Ritual Magic

source_cn: 参与神座之争玩法，并达到血色亲王段位。
ref_en: Participate in the Battle for the Throne of God challenge and reach the Bloody Prince rank.

source_cn: 受邀回到黑荆棘喝咖啡，却听说老尼尔的人生中，曾有一个淡绿色的春天。
ref_en: Invited back to Blackthorn for coffee, you hear that there was once a pale green spring in Old Neil's life.

source_cn: 叫我出来做什么？你终于对《机械制造技术基础》感兴趣了吗？
ref_en: What do you want me for? Are you finally interested in "Fundamentals of Mechanical Manufacturing Technology"?

source_cn: 在场景中自由探索，体验多样的居民生活与互动玩法。
ref_en: Explore freely and experience residents' daily lives and various activities.

source_cn: 夹着蔬菜、芝士、火腿等优质食材的面包，美味加倍，精力重回！
ref_en: Bread filled with high-quality ingredients like vegetables, cheese, and ham. Double the deliciousness, energy restored!
Only after her family fell into ruin...

source_cn: 对了，听说大学区有块很适合野餐的草坪，可以去那慢慢享用。
ref_en: By the way, I heard there is a lawn in the university district that is perfect for a picnic. You can go there and enjoy it slowly.

source_cn: 对方在你的黑名单中，无法查看对方诡秘圈
ref_en: The other person is on your blacklist; cannot view their Mystery Circle.

ref_en: The castle you are about to visit has a high pressure value, which may cause <Highlight> slow loading, lag </>, and other issues. Do you want to continue?
What's happening? The dream is collapsing!

source_cn: 您不是队长，无法进行此操作
ref_en: You are not the captain; cannot perform this operation.

source_cn: 我是有点恐高，我很感激你。
ref_en: I am a bit afraid of heights, but I appreciate it.

ref_en: Bet: Winery failed, this station is not [Winery]

ref_en: Press to move.

source_cn: 支付操作太频繁，请稍后再试。
ref_en: Payment operations are too frequent, please try again later.

source_cn: 支线·美梦成真·第二章第12段
ref_en: Side Quest: Dreams Come True, Chapter 2, Paragraph 12

source_cn: 来面试的？面试还有一小时开始。
ref_en: Here for the interview? The interview starts in an hour.

source_cn: 杰西解开共感手镯，并将魔女带回黑荆棘安保公司...
ref_en: Jesse untied the empathy bracelet and brought the witch back to Blackthorn Security Company...

source_cn: 没错！她是贝克兰德夜总会里最不同的舞女，她的舞姿优美，歌声也动人！
ref_en: That's right! She is the most unique dancer in the Backlund nightclub; her dance moves are graceful, and her singing voice is moving!

source_cn: 玩家<Disable>两两之间</>会被童话魔力形成的连线拴住，结为彼此的舞伴。互为舞伴的双方，一旦<Disable>远离超过8m</>，就会被童话魔力<Disable>强制拖拽到一起并受到高额伤害</>。
ref_en: Players will be tethered to each other <Disable>in pairs</> by threads formed of fairy tale magic, becoming dance partners. Once partners <Disable>move more than 8m apart</>, they will be <Disable>forcibly dragged together by the fairy tale magic and take high damage</>.

source_cn: 病痛缠身感染目标后，目标的攻击力、防御力下降20%。
ref_en: After Afflicted by Illness infects a target, the target's Attack and Defense are reduced by 20%.

source_cn: 看起来脾气很不好的河豚，实际上也确实火爆。
ref_en: A pufferfish that looks like it has a bad temper; in reality, it is indeed hot-tempered.

source_cn: 算了，待会还是问问贝茜吧……
ref_en: Forget it, I'll ask Bessie later...

source_cn: 累计获得5000个金色品质非凡物质
继续探查下去，前面或许就有真相。
ref_en: Continue investigating, the truth might be ahead.

source_cn: 老尼尔，接下来就交给你了。
ref_en: Old Neil, I'll leave the rest to you.
At least it's better than last time.

source_cn: 近日的廷根并不太平。作为值夜者小队的新人，你也被分派了一桩奇异的案件。\n而它指向的，是廷根北区的某个沙龙，以及留驻其中的神秘倩影……
ref_en: Tingen has not been peaceful lately. As a newcomer to the Nighthawks squad, you have also been assigned a strange case. \n It points to a certain salon in the North District of Tingen, and the mysterious beauty residing within...

source_cn: 这取决于序列层次。高序列的圣者或天使确实可能引发大范围的异常天象，但那通常意味着失控或神性外溢，是相当危险的现象。
ref_en: That depends on the sequence level. High-sequence Saints or Angels can indeed trigger large-scale abnormal weather phenomena, but that usually means loss of control or divinity overflow, which is a quite dangerous phenomenon.

source_cn: 这对别人来说就是一间破屋子，卖不了几个钱。
ref_en: To others, this is just a dilapidated house; it won't fetch much money.

source_cn: 这群小家伙吵吵闹闹地要给你办生日派对。对了，我也赌你会忘记自己的生日，感谢配合。来吧克莱恩，十便士。
ref_en: These little ones were making a fuss about throwing you a birthday party. By the way, I also bet that you would forget your own birthday. Thanks for cooperating. Come on, Klein, ten pence.

source_cn: 错误处理机制后被附加变身诅咒
ref_en: Attached with transformation curse after error handling mechanism
Read the letter in the inventory

source_cn: 领主大人，感谢您为这片土地来带希望和明天。
ref_en: My Lord, thank you for bringing hope and a tomorrow to this land.

风车背面的“血迹”，似乎是红色的油漆。
ref_en: The 'bloodstains' on the back of the windmill appear to be red paint.
After 1 second, perform a "Continuous Charge" toward the target

source_cn: <Highlight>工艺：</>狒狒绒毛・精致缝纫\n银色的柔绒小包。（非常适合存放香蕉！）
ref_en: <Highlight>Craft: </>Baboon Fur · Exquisite Stitching\nA soft silver pouch. (Perfect for storing bananas!)

source_cn: <P_Heart>（不一样？梅丽莎发现了什么？虽然接受了原主的记忆，但细节上还是会不小心呈现出自己真实的性格……只能先找个理由了。）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart>(Different? Did Melissa discover something? Although I accepted the original owner's memories, I might accidentally reveal my true personality in the details... I can only find an excuse.)</>

ref_en: <P_Heart> (But just standing here chatting? It's a bit low-class... A mysterious gathering like this should be in an ancient, magnificent temple, right.) </>

source_cn: <P_Heart>（去问问咖啡馆的女士吧，她或许知道些什么……）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart> (Go ask the lady at the cafe, she might know something...) </>

ref_en: <P_Heart>(I need to observe first, then interact... and play the role of a Spectator well.)</>
City Walk: Struck by Lightning While Praying at the Church of the River and Sea

source_cn: 仔细看能发现上面沾着的番茄丁。
ref_en: Looking closely, you can see the diced tomatoes stuck on it.

source_cn: 他说廷根有个大学城，坐飞艇能飞到云上。
ref_en: He said Tingen has a University District, and you can fly above the clouds on an airship.
Peak of the Gods Historical Champion

source_cn: 估计一小时差不多，就按时间算。我们这就出发？
ref_en: An hour should be about right, let's go by time. Shall we set off?

source_cn: 但唯一让我担心的是……她太懂事了……承担了很多不是她这个年纪应该承担的……
ref_en: But the only thing that worries me is... she is too sensible... taking on a lot of things she shouldn't have to at her age...

source_cn: 你们这一晚上十五苏勒，是怎么算的？捉到的老鼠有啥标准不？
ref_en: How did you calculate this 15 soli for the night? Is there a standard for the rats caught?
Why did you come up? Get down quickly!
You don't read much, I don't blame you.

source_cn: 使用后获得<Highlight>魔女的回味套装</>
借格斗学者对格斗技巧的精准解析与钻研，瞬间摆出一套标准到极致的格斗起手式，凝势保持数秒后自然恢复常态。起手式凝练的技巧轨迹留存在周身，让自身下一次攻击同步浮现一道格斗残影，贴合格斗学者 “以窥秘之精，塑格斗之势” 的核心特性。
ref_en: Drawing on the Fighting Scholar's precise analysis and study of combat techniques, you instantly strike a standard, ultimate combat stance. After holding the stance for a few seconds, you naturally return to your normal state. The refined technique trajectory from the stance lingers around you, causing your next attack to manifest a combat afterimage, adhering to the core characteristic of the Fighting Scholar: "Using the essence of mystery to shape the momentum of combat."

source_cn: 光之律动-天赋-额外伤害
ref_en: Rhythm of Light - Talent - Bonus Damage

source_cn: 出自名家手笔的油画习作，每一道笔触间都诉说着故事。
ref_en: An oil painting study by a famous artist; every brushstroke tells a story.

source_cn: 刚才的都是梦境？值夜者？非凡事件？
ref_en: Everything just now was a dream? Nighthawks? Beyonder incidents?

source_cn: 召唤一个灵体附身，当玩家使用技能时，灵体会对目标造成伤害。
ref_en: Summon a spirit to possess you; when the player uses a skill, the spirit deals damage to the target.

source_cn: 可从当前传送点和复活点中，自行选择1个进行复活
ref_en: You may choose 1 from the current teleport point and resurrection point to resurrect

source_cn: 可是这里还有这么多信没送呢……
ref_en: But there are still so many letters here that haven't been delivered...

source_cn: 命中敌人会施加25%减速效果，持续3秒。
ref_en: Hitting an enemy applies a 25% Slow effect for 3 seconds.

source_cn: 在找那些狂热的知识信徒。四十年来，我一直在阻止你们，阻止你们被知识吞没。
ref_en: Searching for those fanatical believers of knowledge. For forty years, I have been stopping you, stopping you from being devoured by knowledge.

source_cn: 如果下一站<LightHighlight>是【食铺】</>,获得自身<LightHighlight>50%</>的<HyperLink stylename="Underline" u="trainTradeItem=30503">【铜雕烛台】</>
ref_en: If the next stop <LightHighlight> is the [Food Shop] </>, obtain an amount of <HyperLink stylename="Underline" u="trainTradeItem=30503"> [Bronze Candlestick] </> equal to <LightHighlight> 50% </> of what you currently possess.

source_cn: 如遇到危险，请及时求助，守卫们将尽全力保障您的安全。
ref_en: If you encounter danger, please ask for help in time, and the guards will do their best to ensure your safety.

source_cn: 安提哥努斯笔记副本攻略
安魂诗社的秘物。一缕发丝轻触额前，安宁便可取代疯狂的归位。\n当发丝触及灵性的一瞬，躁动便自认疲倦，在无人察觉的间隙中，退入那开满夜香草和深眠花的国度，就此沉眠。
ref_en: A mystical item of the Requiem Poetry Society. A strand of hair touches the forehead, and peace can replace the return of madness. \n The moment the hair touches spirituality, the restlessness admits its fatigue, and in a gap that no one notices, it retreats into the kingdom full of night-scented grass and deep-sleep flowers, falling into a slumber there.

source_cn: 小心小丑的诡计！进入没有卡牌花色指示的区域！
ref_en: Beware of the Clown's tricks! Entering an area without card suit indicators!

source_cn: 小托比！太好了！你没有被兔子迷惑！你赢了！
ref_en: Little Toby! That's great! You weren't deceived by the rabbit! You won!

source_cn: 年轻人，你想加入祷告吗？
ref_en: Young man, would you like to join the prayer?

source_cn: 开启可随机获得一件<Highlight>当前开启装等</>的<Highlight>竞技倾向</>橙色或金色品质装备，非凡物质、聚合因子、绑定苏勒。
ref_en: Open to randomly obtain one piece of <Highlight>current level</> <Highlight>Competition-oriented</> orange or gold-quality equipment, Beyonder materials, Aggregation Factors, or bound Sol.

source_cn: 当前正处于自由镜头模式，是否切换为普通镜头？切换后镜头将重置为初始状态。
ref_en: You are currently in free camera mode. Do you want to switch to the normal camera? After switching, the camera will reset to its initial state.

source_cn: 很好，罗塞尔大帝在成为执政官后，开始推广讲卫生，预防、减少以至消灭疾病，提高健康水平的运动。
ref_en: Very well. After becoming Consul, Emperor Roselle began promoting a campaign to emphasize hygiene, prevent, reduce, and even eradicate diseases, and improve health standards.

source_cn: 您是不是晒昏头了？镇上只有我一个园丁呀。
ref_en: Did you get heatstroke? I'm the only gardener in town.

source_cn: 我作为一名医生，应该按照医学的原则来判断生死。
ref_en: As a doctor, I should judge life and death according to medical principles.

source_cn: 我在红月下厮杀，我是你的影子。
ref_en: I fight under the red moon, I am your shadow.

source_cn: 我是从乡下来城里找工作的，急需住处，您看您能不能帮忙介绍一下……
ref_en: I came to the city from the countryside to find work and am in urgent need of a place to stay. Could you please help me introduce it...
I don't need to buy a dog for now

source_cn: 战士-怒意猛击-描述显示用
ref_en: Warrior - Angry Slam - For Description Display

source_cn: 年轻的值夜者尼尔与钢琴调音师莎莉丝特因相亲结识。从咖啡店的尴尬再会到紫藤花廊的悠闲散步，两颗心逐渐靠近。然而疾病夺走了莎莉丝特的生命，留尼尔独自面对寒冬。许多年过去，老尼尔依旧试图找回那个淡绿色的春天，哪怕付出生命的代价。最终，陈旧的信件与木雕钢琴令春天降临。在那场幻梦中的婚礼，相爱的人从此不再分离。
ref_en: Young Nighthawk Neil and piano tuner Celeste meet through a blind date. From the awkward reunion at the coffee shop to the leisurely strolls through the wisteria corridor, their hearts gradually draw closer. However, illness takes Celeste's life, leaving Neil to face the winter alone. Many years later, old Neil still tries to find that pale green spring, even at the cost of his life. In the end, old letters and a wooden piano bring spring back. In that illusory wedding, the lovers are never to be separated again.

source_cn:
他是“星之女王”嘉德丽雅麾下的大副，“未来号”上令人闻风丧胆的“毒素专家”。但弗兰克·李从不认为自己是危险人物——他只是一个热爱土壤、作物和品种杂交技术的农业研究者，一个试图用最直接的方式解决人类饥饿问题的理想主义者。
在他的世界里，公牛与小麦之间没有不可逾越的鸿沟，牛奶与甲板之间也不存在本质的区别。万物皆可杂交，一切皆有可能。这是他对“母亲”的意志最为虔诚的解读。

弗兰克·李的疯狂，是一种纯粹的、近乎天真的疯狂。他从不觉得自己在做危险的事，就像孩子从不觉得把积木搭成奇怪形状有什么不对。他只是看见了饥饿，看见了贫困，然后想出了一个最直接的解决方案——让食物自己长出来，以任何可能的形式，在任何可能的地方。
他试图让牛像麦子一样从地里长出来，这样农民就不需要费心饲养；他培育的蘑菇在“未来号”的甲板下疯狂繁殖，让这艘船开始产奶——对他来说，这是“神迹”，是“仁慈的母亲”对他研究的肯定。他从未想过，一个普通人看见甲板缝隙里渗出乳白色液体时，第一反应会是恐惧而非惊喜。
他是“未来号”上最危险的存在，却也是最无害的灵魂。危险的是他的造物，无害的是他的心。他从不怀有任何恶意，他站在疯狂与天真之间那条模糊的边界上，他坚信，总有一天，世界会理解他的。

“我只是想喂饱所有人。”他会这样说，蓝色的眼睛里满是真诚。
ref_en:
He is the First mate under the command of the “Queen of Stars” Cattleya, and the dreaded “Toxin Expert” on the Future. But Frank Lee never considered himself a dangerous person—he is just an agricultural researcher who loves soil, crops, and cross-breeding technology, an idealist who tries to solve human hunger in the most direct way. 
 In his world, there is no insurmountable gap between bulls and wheat, and there is no essential difference between milk and the deck. Everything can be hybridized, and anything is possible. This is his most devout interpretation of the “Mother’s” will. 
 
 Frank Lee’s madness is a pure, almost naive madness. He never feels that he is doing something dangerous, just as a child never feels that there is anything wrong with building blocks into strange shapes. He just saw hunger, saw poverty, and then came up with the most direct solution—let food grow itself, in any possible form, in any possible place. 
 He tried to make cows grow out of the ground like wheat so that farmers wouldn’t need to worry about raising them; the mushrooms he cultivated reproduced wildly under the deck of the Future, making the ship start to produce milk—to him, this is a “miracle,” a confirmation of his research by the “merciful Mother.” He never thought that when an ordinary person saw milky white liquid seeping out of the cracks in the deck, the first reaction would be fear rather than surprise. 
 He is the most dangerous existence on the Future, but also the most harmless soul. What is dangerous is his creation, and what is harmless is his heart. He never harbors any malice; he stands on the blurred boundary between madness and innocence, and he firmly believes that one day, the world will understand him. 
 
 “I just want to feed everyone.” He would say this, his blue eyes full of sincerity.

对前方范围内敌方发动刺击，造成*d点魔法伤害，命中时消耗全部<HighLight>足迹</>召唤残影进行追击（至多提升至*d点魔法伤害），并为敌方施加<HighLight>坠落</>，自身获得<HighLight>闪回</>。
<FaintYellow>坠落</>
使敌方怪物<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">浮空</>。若消耗2层以上<HighLight>足迹</>，有<HighLight>42%</>的基础概率对敌方施加*f秒buffdisc(*id)的效果，若消耗3层<HighLight>足迹</>，有<HighLight>70%</>的基础概率使敌方玩家<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">浮空</>，玩家目标被本技能<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">浮空</>后，短时间内无法再次被本技能<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">浮空</>。
<FaintYellow>闪回</>
减少<HighLight>放逐</>、<HighLight>星云咏叹</>、<HighLight>戏法演绎</>、<HighLight>记录</>1秒冷却时间，若消耗3层<HighLight>足迹</>，额外减少<HighLight>skillname(*id)</>2秒冷却时间。
ref_en:
Perform a stab on enemies in the range in front, dealing *d magic damage. Upon hitting, consume all <HighLight>Footprints</> to summon a remnant to pursue (up to *d magic damage), apply <HighLight>Falling</> to enemies, and gain <HighLight>Flashback</>. 
<FaintYellow>Falling</>
 causes enemy monsters to be <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">launched</>. If more than 2 stacks of <HighLight>Footprints</> are consumed, there is a <HighLight>42%</> base chance to apply, for *f seconds, the effect of buffdisc(*id). If 3 stacks of <HighLight>Footprints</> are consumed, there is a <HighLight>70%</> base chance to <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">launch</> enemy players. After being <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">launched</> by this skill, player targets cannot be <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">launched</> again by this skill for a short time. 
<FaintYellow>Flashback</>

source_cn:
金秋湖，一片与世无争的田园乐土。
这里有自然的恩赐、永恒的生长，在丰饶树的眷顾下，连绵不绝的金色丰收如同一副画卷——直到一场污染降临，让丰收变成了一种灾难。
亩产千斤的葡萄、堆积成山的稻田、还有永远永远剪不完的羊毛……森林中的动物也受到影响，巨大的龟咆哮而出，狒狒们快乐起舞……人们接二连三地逃离金秋小镇，非凡者和值夜者们留了下来：“保护金秋湖，不能让污染毁掉这里！”
  一场轰轰烈烈的金秋湖保卫战，就此拉开序幕。
ref_en:
Golden Autumn Lake, a peaceful pastoral paradise. 
 Here, there are the gifts of nature and eternal growth. Under the blessing of the Tree of Abundance, the endless golden harvest is like a painting—until a corruption descends, turning the harvest into a disaster. 
 Grapes with a yield of thousands of pounds, mountains of rice paddies, and wool that can never be finished shearing... The animals in the forest are also affected; giant turtles roar, and baboons dance happily... People flee the town of Golden Autumn one after another, but the Beyonders and Nighthawks remain: "Protect Golden Autumn Lake, we cannot let the corruption destroy this place!" 
 A grand battle to defend Golden Autumn Lake begins.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【灵体之线】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>碰触万物相连的灵体之线，就能与其建立连接，接管其意识，使其成为你的秘偶，被你控制的单位将听从你的指令。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找灵体之线</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【灵体之线】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【灵体之线】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 操控秘偶</>
到达目标区域后，使用<Assistant_Red>【附身】</>技能控制指定单位，并运用秘偶的能力完成对应挑战。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 完成挑战</>
成功完成挑战后，即可开启宝箱并领取奖励
<Assistant_Title1>【助手提示】</>
开启【附身】后，可以附身的单位上方往往出现<Assistant_Red>【可附身】</>标签提示，注意观察四周~
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【spirit body threads】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>By touching the spirit body threads that connect all things, you can establish a connection with them, take over their consciousness, and make them your marionette. Units controlled by you will obey your commands.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding spirit body threads</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [spirit body threads] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [spirit body threads] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Controlling a Marionette</>
After arriving at the target area, use the <Assistant_Red>[Possession]</> skill to control the designated unit and use the marionette's abilities to complete the corresponding challenge.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Completing the Challenge</>
After successfully completing the challenge, you can open the treasure chest and claim your reward.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【异象之物】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>受当地非凡事件影响而形成的沾染灵性之物，<Assistant_Red>触碰</>即可收集。积累一定数量后可前往某位值夜者处兑换奖励。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 收集异象之物</>
探索过程中，可留意散发光芒的晶状物，靠近并触碰即可完成收集。
也可通过以下方式寻找异象之物：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【异象之物】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【异象之物】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 兑换奖励</>
收集足够数量的异象之物后，前往<Assistant_Red>黑荆棘安保公司</>附近，与<Assistant_Red>伦纳德</>对话即可兑换奖励。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Object of Phenomenon】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>Items contaminated by spirituality formed under the influence of local Beyonder incidents. <Assistant_Red>Touch </>them to collect them. After accumulating a certain amount, you can exchange them for rewards at a Nighthawk.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Collecting Objects of Phenomenon</>
During exploration, keep an eye out for glowing crystalline objects; approach and touch them to complete collection.
You can also find them using the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Object of Phenomenon] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Object of Phenomenon] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Exchanging Rewards</>
After collecting enough Objects of Phenomenon, go to the vicinity of the <Assistant_Red>Blackthorn Security Company</> and speak with <Assistant_Red>Leonard</> to exchange them for rewards.

I really like the gift you sent last time, thank you. This wooden piano might be crudely made, but it's just right for my desk.

<Assistant_Title1>【命运时刻】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>命运时刻</>是<Assistant_Red>12对12多人战场</>。非凡者会分为两个阵营，每场对局持续<Assistant_Red>4分钟</>。对局结束时，分数较高的一方获胜；若积分相同，则依次比较击杀数、伤害量，均相同则随机一方获胜。
<Assistant_Title2>积分获取：</>可通过拾取<Assistant_Property1>增益光点</>、击杀、助攻、进入<Assistant_Property1>纷争漩涡</>争夺来获得积分。增益光点会提供积分及属性加成；纷争漩涡倒计时结束时，仍留在漩涡内的非凡者会平分积分。
<Assistant_Title2>汇集锚点：</>对局内会出现汇集锚点并持续<Assistant_Red>15秒</>。根据锚点需求人数进入锚点并达到要求后，持续<Assistant_Red>3秒</>即可将本阵营非凡者集结至此，参与集结的非凡者会获得限时属性加成。
<Assistant_Title2>匹配规则：</>玩法入口显示开放时间为<Assistant_Red>10:00-1:00</>。命运时刻最多允许<Assistant_Red>3人组队匹配</>。
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>{JumpToUI:[前往命运时刻]|1250095}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Moment of Fate】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description:</><Assistant_System>Moment of Fate</> is a <Assistant_Red>12v12 multiplayer battlefield</>. Beyonders are divided into two factions, and each match lasts <Assistant_Red>4 minutes</>. When the match ends, the side with the higher score wins; if the points are equal, compare kills, then damage dealt; if all are the same, a random side wins.
<Assistant_Title2>Point Acquisition:</>You can obtain points by picking up <Assistant_Property1>Buff Orbs</>, killing, assisting, and entering the <Assistant_Property1>Vortex of Strife</> to compete. Buff Orbs provide points and attribute bonuses; when the countdown for the Vortex of Strife ends, Beyonders remaining in the vortex will split the points equally.
<Assistant_Title2>Gathering Anchor:</>Gathering Anchors will appear in the match and last for <Assistant_Red>15 seconds</>. After entering the anchor and reaching the required number of people, stay for <Assistant_Red>3 seconds</> to assemble your faction's Beyonders here; Beyonders participating in the assembly will receive a time-limited attribute bonus.
<Assistant_Title2>Matchmaking Rules:</>The gameplay entry shows the opening time as <Assistant_Red>10:00-1:00</>. Moment of Fate allows a maximum of <Assistant_Red>3-player team matchmaking</>.
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Method:</>{JumpToUI:[Go to Moment of Fate]|1250095}

source_cn:
丰饶之树最初只是一粒小小的种子。
它沉眠于大地母神教会中，由圣者精心保管。圣者知晓它身负生机与荒芜两种强大的力量，不能被轻易种下。
直到那场背弃誓言的战争降临。大地化为焦土，生机纷纷湮灭，圣者站在同伴和敌人的尸体间，落下了一滴泪。 
至少，要让这片大地重生。 
种子进入泥土后迅速生长，生机怦然降临之时，荒芜也伸出爪牙——于是圣者挺身而出，将无尽的荒芜统统纳入身躯。
变动终于平息，丰饶之树睁开了眼睛。
她化为人形的灵体，懵懂如婴孩，裹着一袭金色的披风。 
一个遥远的声音在她心头回荡： 
这是大地的礼物。
这是丰饶的呼唤。
ref_en:
The Tree of Abundance was initially just a tiny seed. 
 It slept in the Church of the Earth Mother, carefully kept by a Saint. The Saint knew that it carried two powerful forces, Vitality and Desolation, and could not be planted easily. 
 Until the war that betrayed the oath arrived. The earth turned into scorched earth, and vitality was annihilated one after another. The Saint stood between the corpses of companions and enemies and shed a tear. 
 At least, let this land be reborn. 
 After the seed entered the soil, it grew rapidly. When vitality descended suddenly, desolation also stretched out its claws—so the Saint stepped forward and took all the endless desolation into her body. 
 The turmoil finally subsided, and the Tree of Abundance opened its eyes. 
 She turned into a human-shaped spirit, ignorant as an infant, wrapped in a golden cloak. 
 A distant voice echoed in her heart: 
 This is the gift of the earth. 
 This is the call of Harvest.

ref_en: You meet Terry on the streets of Tingen, who is being bullied by the Dragon Hunter Gang again, and decide to seek justice for him. After teaching the thugs a lesson, you accidentally learn that they are preparing for an absurd 'Dragon Hunting Operation'—this was the grand ideal of Ray Bieber when he founded the Dragon Hunter Gang, which his good brother Kevin is determined to inherit. Of course, in front of a real giant dragon, the tiny Dragon Hunter Gang is still too tiny. But so what? They still have ideals, they are still persisting, and they can still start over—by bragging about non-existent 'Hero Slaying Dragons' at the Evil Dragon Bar to recruit gang members...

<Title>限时顶奢</>
战略服结算时，最终排名第一的势力中，四个俱乐部的<Highlight>会长、副会长、理事</>可获得限时30天的顶奢时装<Highlight>铁与血之歌</>。

ref_en:
<Title> Divine Selection Seats </> 
 During the Strategic Server faction battle phase, Divine Selection Seats are composed of <Highlight> Weekly Ranking Settlement Seats </> and <Highlight> Final Ranking Settlement Seats </>. Every week, seats will be distributed based on the weekly rankings of each faction on the Strategic Server and the club's ranking within its faction; the higher the ranking, the more seats can be obtained. Upon the Strategic Server settlement, Final Ranking Settlement Seats will be distributed to clubs within the faction based on the final rankings of each faction. The Divine Selection Seats obtained by a club are distributed internally by the club management. 
 
 <Title> Reward Content </> 
 Divine Selection rewards include <Highlight> Strategic Server exclusive cosmetic rewards, cultivation items, Soules, Bound Pounds </>, etc. 
 
 <Title> Limited-Time Top Luxury </> 
 Upon the Strategic Server settlement, the <Highlight> President, Vice President, and Council Members </> of the four clubs in the faction that ranks first overall can obtain the 30-day limited-time top luxury outfit <Highlight> Song of Iron and Blood </>. 
 
 <Title> Reward Distribution </> 
 Rewards will be distributed uniformly <Highlight> after the Strategic Server Victory Declaration Ceremony concludes </>.

source_cn:
当午夜的钟声敲响，当星辰在天幕闪烁，当你在梦境与现实的边界徘徊——你听到了吗？那来自深处的低语，那安宁的呼唤。

　　我们是安魂诗社。

　　在女神的注视下，我们是夜晚的守护者，是亡者的歌者，是秘密的守卫。我们相信：

　　黑夜不是恐惧的源头，而是安宁的居所。死亡不是终结的悲哀，而是解脱的开始。我们用诗歌抚慰失眠者，用仪式安抚亡灵，用沉默守护那些不能言说的秘密。

　　若你愿意加入我们，请在新月之夜来到拉斐尔墓园深处，吟诵祷词：

　　"女神啊，请让安宁降临，
　　让梦境包裹疲惫的灵魂，
　　让黑夜庇护迷途的羔羊。"

　　我们会在黑暗中迎接你。
　　我们会在静谧中认可你。
　　我们会在诗歌中铭记你。

　　但请记住，成为安魂诗社的一员，意味着你将承担起相应的责任——在他人入眠时保持清醒，在世界喧嚣时保持沉默，在光明炽烈时拥抱黑暗。

　　你，准备好了吗？  愿黑夜庇护你，愿安宁与你同在。
ref_en:
When the midnight bell tolls, when the stars blink in the sky, when you wander on the boundary between dreams and reality—do you hear it? That whisper from the depths, that peaceful call.

	We are the Requiem Poetry Society.

	Under the Goddess's Gaze, we are the Guardians of the night, the singers for the dead, and the keepers of secrets. We believe:

	The night is not the source of horror, but a dwelling of peace. Death is not the sorrow of an end, but the beginning of liberation. We use poetry to comfort the insomniac, rituals to pacify the spirits, and silence to guard those unspeakable secrets.

	If you are willing to join us, please come to the depths of Raphael Cemetery on the night of the new moon and recite the prayer:

	"Oh Goddess, please let peace descend,
	Let dreams wrap around the weary soul,
	Let the night shelter the lost lamb."

	We will welcome you in the darkness.
	We will acknowledge you in the silence.
	We will remember you in our poetry.

	But please remember, becoming a member of the Requiem Poetry Society means you will shoulder corresponding responsibilities—staying awake while others sleep, remaining silent while the world is noisy, and embracing the darkness while the light is intense.

	Are you ready? May the night shelter you, and may peace be with you.
